The season starts with 16 teams, an asymmetric-order home-and-away regular season, Top 8 playoffs and two annual relegation slots. The playoff bracket is explicit from quarterfinal seeds through semifinal paths and final. Trapani Shark's in-season exclusion and the annulment of its played games are deliberately not baked into the static format: an excluded club counts among relegated clubs under the FIP DOA, and FIP consequently reduced the remaining sporting relegations to one. That is a mutable competition event/runtime concern, not a different league format. | PASS65 source supports seasonSchedule; content not transcribed.

competitions.format_notes: FFBB 2025/26: 28 teams in two geographic pools of 14, double round robin. In phase 2 the top seven from each phase-1 pool form group A and ranks 8-14 form group B; matches already played in phase 1 are not replayed and direct results are carried forward, with home-and-away matches between teams from opposite phase-1 pools. Group A ranks 1-8 reach phase-3 playoffs; rank 1 of group A gains sporting access to Elite 2 subject to regulatory/financial approval. Playoffs consist of quarter-finals, semifinals and final, each two wins (best of three), with the better phase-2 rank hosting game 2 and any game 3. Playoff winner is champion and accesses Elite 2; if group A rank 1 wins playoffs, the finalist gets access instead. Group B ranks 11-14 are relegated to NM2, except P?le France; exact playoff seed pairings, complete tie-break sequence and all fallback access cases are not modeled; PARTIAL.

competitions.format_notes: Thirty teams play 82 regular-season games. The published schedule initially fixes 80 games per team; two December games are conditional on Emirates NBA Cup Group Play outcomes. Eastern and Western Conference identity is persistent B02 structure, not temporary B04 groups. The top six teams in each conference qualify directly for the playoffs; ranks 7-10 enter the SoFi Play-In. Each playoff round is best-of-seven using 2-2-1-1-1 hosting. First-round pairings are 1-8, 4-5, 3-6 and 2-7 within each conference.

The season starts with 16 teams, an asymmetric-order home-and-away regular season, Top 8 playoffs and two annual relegation slots. The playoff bracket is explicit from quarterfinal seeds through semifinal paths and final. Trapani Shark's in-season exclusion and the annulment of its played games are deliberately not baked into the static format: an excluded club counts among relegated clubs under the FIP DOA, and FIP consequently reduced the remaining sporting relegations to one. That is a mutable competition event/runtime concern, not a different league format. | PASS65 source supports seasonSchedule; content not transcribed.

Trapani Shark's in-season exclusion and the annulment of its played games are deliberately not baked into the static format: an excluded club counts among relegated clubs under the FIP DOA, and FIP consequently reduced the remaining sporting relegations to one. The season starts with 16 teams, an asymmetric-order home-and-away regular season, Top 8 playoffs and two annual relegation slots. The playoff bracket is explicit from quarterfinal seeds through semifinal paths and final. Trapani Shark's in-season exclusion and the annulment of its played games are deliberately not baked into the static format: an excluded club counts among relegated clubs under the FIP DOA, and FIP consequently reduced the remaining sporting relegations to one. That is a mutable competition event/runtime concern, not a different league format. | PASS65 source supports seasonSchedule; content not transcribed.
